description: A tremolo, swinging the level of the signal with an oscillator whose wave morphs from sine to triangle

params.text: Morphs the modulating wave from a sine at one end of its travel to a triangle at the other
Sets how fast the level swings, about 1Hz to 11Hz
Crossfades between the incoming signal and the tremolo
Turns the modulating wave upside down, which puts two of these modules in opposite phase for a stereo effect
Takes the effect out of the circuit, fading rather than switching so nothing clicks

inputs.text: Added to the SHAPE knob, a volt covering the knob's whole travel
Added to the SPEED knob, 10V covering the knob's whole travel
Added to the BLEND knob, 10V covering the knob's whole travel
A trigger here takes the effect out of the circuit, and a second trigger puts it back
A trigger here restarts the modulating wave from the beginning of its cycle

outputs.text: The signal with the tremolo on it

inputs.4: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.5: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
